title: Rav Menashya son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Beitzah 30b. The Bach reads “Rav Menashya said in the name of Shmuel,” as does the Venice printing.[^1][^2]

notes.text: הב״ח is retained conventionally as the Bach, without expanding its Hebrew acronym or inferring an editor identity. The Bach and Venice readings are Hyman’s attributions, not fresh inspections.

ל: gives Beitzah 30b under the colon convention. The frozen father’s רבא is Rava; the old Rabba rendering is not adopted. Hyman’s alternative supplies Rav Menashya reporting in Shmuel’s name, a different relation from the heading’s son-of-Rava. Both full רב occurrences remain Rav; neither Rava nor Shmuel gains an absent personal title.
